title: Index-one DVR extensions with separable residue extension are adically formally smooth
statement: Let $R\to S$ be an injective local homomorphism of discrete valuation rings [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring], where local means that the inverse image of $\mathfrak m_S$ is $\mathfrak m_R$. Suppose $\mathfrak m_RS=\mathfrak m_S$, and suppose the induced residue field extension $(S/\mathfrak m_S)/(R/\mathfrak m_R)$ is separable in the possibly transcendental sense of [def-weil-pbc-separable-field-extension]. Then $S$ is formally smooth over $R$ for the $\mathfrak m_S$-adic topology [def-weil-pbc-formally-smooth-adic]. Neither completeness nor finite generation of the residue field extension is assumed.

proof.text: Write $\varphi:R\to S$ for the given map. By [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring], both rings are local domains and every ideal is principal. Thus every ideal is finitely generated, so both rings are Noetherian by [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Also $R$ is a PID. For $0\ne r\in R$ and $s\in S$, $rs=0$ means $\varphi(r)s=0$. Injectivity gives $\varphi(r)\ne0$; since $S$ is a domain, $s=0$. Hence $S$ is torsion free as an $R$-module. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-pid-torsion-free-module-flat] to conclude that $R\to S$ is flat.

Put $k=R/\mathfrak m_R$ and $L=S/\mathfrak m_S$. The local-map condition induces the stated field embedding $k\hookrightarrow L$. The closed fibre used in [lem-weil-pbc-flat-formally-smooth-closed-fibre-adic] is $\overline S=S/\mathfrak m_RS$. The hypothesis $\mathfrak m_RS=\mathfrak m_S$ identifies this quotient with $L$, by the map sending the class of $s$ to its residue class. This identification preserves the $k$-algebra structure, and its maximal ideal $\mathfrak m_S/\mathfrak m_RS$ is zero. For any $k$-algebra $D$, square-zero ideal $J$ and map $L\to D/J$, [lem-sfb-separable-field-square-zero-lifting] supplies a $k$-algebra lift $L\to D$, since $L/k$ is separable in the assumed, possibly transcendental sense. In particular this holds for every map continuous for the zero-adic topology. By [def-weil-pbc-formally-smooth-adic], $\overline S$ is formally smooth over $k$ for its maximal-ideal-adic topology.

source.place: Tag 0322, proposition-characterize-separable-field-extensions: characteristic-zero assertion (3), positive-characteristic implication (1) to (6); used by More on Algebra Tag 09E7.

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-flat-formally-smooth-closed-fibre-adic] with $A=R$ and $B=S$. The map is local by hypothesis, both rings are Noetherian and the map is flat by step 1, and step 2 gives precisely formal smoothness of its closed fibre for the quotient maximal ideal. The criterion gives that $S$ is formally smooth over $R$ for the $\mathfrak m_S$-adic topology. The cited criterion and separable-field lifting theorem impose neither completeness nor finite generation, so none has been added.
